title: Rest gallery — every rest length
description: Every rest the renderer draws, longest to shortest over 17 bars of 4/4: a sequence-level fullMeasure rest, then maxima / longa / breve (each resting its own bar), whole, half, quarter, eighth through 128th rests alternating with notes so the rhythm reads, the tiny 256th / 512th / 1024th rests, and dotted rests (dotted half; dotted quarter + dotted eighth mix). Bars with timed content sum exactly to 4/4, so no validation markers should appear; single-rest bars use the full-measure-rest convention.
